beats.title: A Warning at the Cave
beats.narration_summary: A warm evening in the Seeonee hills. Father Wolf wakes; Tabaqui the jackal visits and says Shere Khan the tiger will hunt here. Father Wolf is angry; Mother Wolf explains Shere Khan is lame.
clues: Tabaqui makes mischief
Shere Khan changed hunting grounds without warning
Shere Khan is lame (Lungri)
tigers should not hunt Man

choice.prompt: Tabaqui whines that Shere Khan is coming. What should Father Wolf do?

spoiler_reveals: a baby arrives at the cave

beats.title: The Man's Cub
beats.narration_summary: A naked baby wanders in and is not afraid. Father Wolf carries him gently to the cubs. Shere Khan demands the baby but the cave is too narrow; Mother Wolf, Raksha, refuses and names him Mowgli the Frog.
clues: the baby is a man's cub
Mother Wolf is called Raksha, the Demon
Shere Khan's feet are burned from the campfire
the cave mouth is too narrow for a tiger

choice.prompt: Shere Khan roars at the cave mouth. What does Mother Wolf do?

cards.note: Both lead to B3; canon is B2-a.

beats.title: The Council Rock
beats.narration_summary: The Pack meets at the Council Rock. Akela leads. The wolves cry 'Look well'. Baloo and Bagheera speak for Mowgli; Bagheera offers a fat bull. The Pack accepts Mowgli.
clues: a cub must be spoken for by two besides his parents
Baloo teaches the cubs the Law
Bagheera pays a bull
Mowgli is entered into the Seeonee Pack

choice.prompt: Akela asks, 'Who speaks for this cub?' Who should speak first?

beats.title: The Red Flower
beats.narration_summary: Ten years pass. Mowgli grows up in the jungle but must never eat cattle. Bagheera warns that Shere Khan is his enemy, shows his collar mark, and tells Mowgli to fetch the Red Flower. Mowgli takes a fire pot from a village boy.
clues: Mowgli can never eat cattle because a bull bought him
Bagheera was born among men
the Red Flower is fire
Akela is getting old

choice.prompt: Bagheera says Mowgli needs the Red Flower. How should Mowgli get it?

cards.note: Canon: Mowgli watches, then takes the pot.

beats.title: Farewell to the Pack
beats.narration_summary: Akela has missed his kill. At the Council Rock, Shere Khan demands Mowgli. Mowgli shows the Red Flower, drives the wolves away, saves Akela, and decides to leave the jungle for men. He cries and says goodbye to his wolf family.
clues: Akela missed his kill and is the Dead Wolf
the wolves fear the Red Flower
Mowgli promises not to betray the Pack
Mowgli cries for the first time

choice.prompt: Mowgli holds the fire. What does he do first?

spoiler_reveals: events in later chapters: Kaa's Hunting, Tiger! Tiger!

ending.summary: Mowgli goes down the hill alone to meet men; the quest wraps up with a badge summary.
